title: Jerk Chicken
description: Chicken marinated overnight in scotch bonnet, allspice, and thyme, then cooked slowly over indirect heat. The pimento wood is the traditional smoke; a covered grill gets close.
notes: Allspice — pimento — is doing more work here than the chilli. Buy it whole and grind it.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs and drumsticks
ingredients.note: bone in, skin on, slashed to the bone

steps.text: Blend the scotch bonnet peppers, spring onions, allspice berries, thyme, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, brown sugar, lime juice, nutmeg, and cinnamon into a coarse marinade.
Work it into the slashed chicken thighs and drumsticks, getting into every cut.
steps.tip: Wear gloves. Scotch bonnet oil stays on your hands for hours.

steps.text: Set the grill up for indirect heat — coals banked to one side, chicken on the other — and cook with the lid on.
steps.tip: Direct heat burns the sugar in the marinade long before the thigh is cooked through.

steps.text: Move the pieces over the coals for the last stretch to char the skin, turning often.
Rest, then chop through the bone into pieces to serve.
